BiblicalUsage: tsîyûwn is the Bible's word for a pillar, a monument. In 2 Kings 23:17, he said, What title is that that I see, and it appears again in Jeremiah 31:21.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put tsîyûwn exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
